mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.username, u.password_digest, u.temporary_password_expires_at, u.role, u.status, u.tenant_id, u.credential_version, t.status AS tenant_status FROM app_user u LEFT JOIN tenant t ON t.id = u.tenant_id WHERE u.username = #{p.username}

SELECT u.id, u.username, u.password_digest, u.temporary_password_expires_at, u.role, u.status, u.tenant_id, u.credential_version, t.status AS tenant_status FROM app_user u LEFT JOIN tenant t ON t.id = u.tenant_id WHERE u.id = #{p.userId}

SELECT s.id AS session_id, s.user_id, s.credential_version AS session_credential_version, s.expires_at, s.revoked_at, u.username, u.role, u.status, u.tenant_id, u.credential_version AS user_credential_version, u.temporary_password_expires_at, t.status AS tenant_status FROM user_session s JOIN app_user u ON u.id = s.user_id LEFT JOIN tenant t ON t.id = u.tenant_id WHERE s.token_digest = #{p.tokenDigest}
mapper.update: UPDATE user_session SET last_used_at = #{p.now} WHERE id = #{p.sessionId} AND last_used_at < #{p.touchBefore}
UPDATE app_user SET last_active_at = #{p.now} WHERE id = #{p.userId} AND (last_active_at IS NULL OR last_active_at < #{p.touchBefore})
mapper.select: UPDATE app_user SET password_digest = #{p.passwordDigest}, temporary_password_expires_at = NULL, credential_version = credential_version + 1, updated_at = #{p.now} WHERE id = #{p.userId} AND credential_version = #{p.expectedVersion} RETURNING credential_version
mapper.update: INSERT INTO auth_rate_limit(id, entry_point, subject_digest, window_started_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{p.id}, 'LOGIN', #{p.subjectDigest}, #{p.windowStart}, #{p.now}) ON CONFLICT (entry_point, subject_digest, window_started_at) DO NOTHING
DELETE FROM auth_rate_limit WHERE entry_point = 'LOGIN' AND subject_digest = #{p.subjectDigest}
